title: VehicleDetailResponse
description: Typed AAP response for the `inventory.vehicle` skill. The `data` field is a Vehicle (v1.0 unified the former Vehicle + VehicleDetail into one type) and MAY be any vehicle type (`car`, `motorcycle`, `trailer`, `rv`, `other`), carrying the type-relevant fields (absent `vehicle_type` = car). Because it is always an inventory listing, `condition` is constrained to `new` | `used` | `cpo` and `status` (one of `available` | `intransit` | `pending`) is required. Shared by MCP structured results, A2A DataParts and native PAP OpenAPI bodies.
